title: Known Tracker Domains Not Blocked
dataSources: UniFi controller events (`unifi:event`), Pi-hole query log (`pihole:query`), AdGuard Home (`adguard:query`), speedtest-cli results (`speedtest:result`), router/firewall syslog, ISP uptime probes (`uptime:probe`).
app: UniFi / router syslog, Pi-hole/AdGuard, and scheduled speedtests via HEC scripted inputs and the Universal Forwarder.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=pihole:query
| where blocked!="true" AND match(domain,"(?i)doubleclick|googlesyndication|facebook|scorecardresearch|branch\.io")
| stats count as queries by client domain
| sort - queries
description: Lists requests to common tracker domains that still slipped through unblocked, helping you tune blocklists based on real household traffic.
value: An ad blocker is never perfect; this query helps you improve it with evidence rather than folklore.
implementation: Forward Pi-hole query logs with blocked state and domain; review recurring allowed tracker traffic and adjust lists if desired.
visualization: Table of clients and tracker domains seen without blocking.
grandmaExplanation: It checks which well-known tracking domains are still getting through your blocker and being contacted by devices at home.
